name: Gianneschi Pumps and Blowers
note: Italian maker of pumps, blowers and water systems for the nautical sector, established 1969; since 2016 run by the founder's sons Alessandro and Cristiano Gianneschi (its description on Gresini Racing's partner page). Official Sponsor of BK8 Gresini Racing MotoGP (Gresini Racing partner page, 2026); the team announced a partnership extension with Gianneschi on 2026-09-24 (gresiniracing.com news). Current ownership shares not sourced; not yet researched.
